 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u055/system/state/workspace/programs/task-010bba40.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    border = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    # The 3-colored rectangular frame defines the interior bounds; the lone
    # interior 3 is the center from which alternating square rings grow.
    r0 = min(r for r, c in border)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in border)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in border)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in border)
    seed = [(r, c) for r in range(r0 + 1, r1) for c in range(c0 + 1, c1) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    if not seed:
        return out
    sr, sc = seed[0]
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            d = max(abs(r - sr), abs(c - sc))
            out[r][c] = 3 if d == 0 else (4 if d % 2 == 1 else 2)
    return out
"
